summary_1line: A sage advises a dispossessed king on detachment from wealth and offers a pragmatic strategy to regain power through humility, alliances, and political cunning.

image_candidates.scene_text: A fallen king listens in the wilderness as a sage instructs him to humble himself before his enemies to regain his kingdom.
The exiled king is imagined living alone in a deep forest among large-tusked elephants, surviving on fruits and roots.
Courtiers gather around King Janaka of Mithila while the humbled exile stands with folded hands seeking service and alliance.
